commands: set -e; echo '--- emulator log ---'; tail -200 /tmp/shelly-link-emulator.log 2>/dev/null || true; echo '--- avd config ---'; cat $HOME/.android/avd/medium_phone.avd/config.ini 2>/dev/null || true; echo '--- avd ini ---'; cat $HOME/.android/avd/medium_phone.ini 2>/dev/null || true; echo '--- sdk packages matching system image/emulator ---'; SDK=${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}; grep -E 'Pkg.Revision|Pkg.Path|AndroidVersion.ApiLevel|SystemImage.Abi' $HOME/.android/avd/medium_phone.avd/package.xml 2>/dev/null || true; "$SDK/emulator/emulator" -version | head -20; echo '--- adb ---'; "$SDK/platform-tools/adb" devices -l
